description: This file defines the PersistableProductReview class, which extends ProductReviewEntity and adds a customerId field with getter and setter methods. It is a serializable Java class used likely for persisting product review data with customer association.

classes.name: PersistableProductReview
classes.description: A Java class representing a persistable product review with customer identification, extending ProductReviewEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with this product review.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for this product review.
